wizard.title: Set up your scholarship journey
wizard.s1Title: Which level do you want to study?
wizard.s1Desc: The study level determines scholarship types and application requirements.
wizard.s1Bachelor: Bachelor scholarships usually assess transcripts/SAT & extracurriculars.
wizard.s1Master: The most government & university scholarships; assessed on GPA, IELTS, experience.
wizard.s1Phd: Research track — usually requires contacting a professor & a research proposal.
wizard.s2Title: Which fields do you want to pursue?
wizard.s2Desc: Pick one or more fields — the system matches them against each scholarship's scope.
wizard.s2Hint: {{n}} fields selected. Pick related fields (e.g. AI + Computer Science) to increase matches.
wizard.s3Title: Where do you want to go?
wizard.s3Desc: Pick preferred countries — click a region name to quickly select the whole group.
wizard.s4Desc: Used for Match Score — enter honestly for accurate recommendations.
wizard.s5Desc: The minimum funding you need, and the provider types you prefer.
wizard.s5PartD: Willing to cover part of the costs yourself.
wizard.s6Sup: Are you willing to contact a supervising professor?
wizard.s6SupYesD: MEXT, CSC, NUS RS… need a professor's acceptance
wizard.s6SupNoD: Chevening, Erasmus, GKS… apply directly, no professor needed
wizard.s7Desc: Review your choices — you can always adjust filters or rerun this wizard.
wizard.previewSub2: rate "Good match" or better for your profile
wizard.noneWarn: No scholarship matches all your choices yet. Go back and loosen some criteria (add countries, drop the rank filter…).
wizard.needField: Select at least 1 field to continue
wizard.needCountry: Select at least 1 country to continue
wizard.footerNote: Choices are saved to your profile on this device — adjust anytime via ⚙️ Profile or rerun the wizard.

professors.title: Find a supervising professor
professors.desc: Research scholarships (MEXT, CSC, NUS RS, Gates Cambridge…) usually need a professor's acceptance before applying. Search by research direction, review publications & use the outreach email assistant.
professors.searchPh: Name, university, research keywords (e.g. computer vision, batteries)…
professors.empty: No matching professors found. Try other keywords or remove some filters.
professors.tipPre: Open a professor's profile to use the

profDetail.outreachDesc: An email template personalized to the professor's research & your profile. Read 1–2 of their publications carefully and fill in the [bracketed] parts before sending.
profDetail.tip1: References a specific publication by the professor
profDetail.tip2: States clearly why you're a fit & attaches your CV
profDetail.tip3: Send from your personal email (the system never mass-sends — anti-spam)
profDetail.warn: Publicly available professional information (demo). Reach out responsibly; do not mass-email.
profDetail.emailTpl:
Subject: Prospective {{level}} applicant interested in your research on {{kw}}

Dear {{name}},

My name is [Your name], currently [your background/major]. I am particularly interested in your research on {{kws}}, especially the work "{{pub}}" ({{pubYear}}).

I plan to apply to {{uni}} and would be honored to be considered for your supervision. My background is a good fit because [1-2 specific reasons: skills, projects, grades].

Please find attached my CV and [research proposal/transcript]. May I ask whether you are accepting graduate students for the coming intake? I would greatly appreciate the opportunity to discuss further.

Sincerely,
[Your name] — [email] — [CV/profile link]
